name: KromiumCookieManager
description: Interface for managing cookies across the browser engine. Provides suspending Kotlin coroutine and Java CompletableFuture APIs to query, set, delete, clear, and flush HTTP cookies to disk.
whenToUse: Obtain via engine.cookieManager to manipulate cookies globally across all browser sessions.

properties.name: timeoutMs
properties.description: Timeout for cookie retrieval operations in milliseconds.

methods.name: getCookies
methods.signature: suspend fun getCookies(url: String, includeHttpOnly: Boolean = true): Map<String, String>
methods.description: Retrieves all cookies for the specified url as a key-value map.

methods.name: getCookiesAsync
methods.signature: fun getCookiesAsync(url: String, includeHttpOnly: Boolean = true): CompletableFuture<Map<String, String>>
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all cookies for url returning a Java CompletableFuture.

methods.name: getCookie
methods.signature: suspend fun getCookie(url: String, name: String): String?
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific cookie by name for url.

methods.name: getCookieAsync
methods.signature: fun getCookieAsync(url: String, name: String): CompletableFuture<String?>
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a specific cookie by name for url returning a Java CompletableFuture.

methods.name: getAllCookies
methods.description: Retrieves all cookies across all domains stored in the engine's global cookie store.

methods.name: getAllCookiesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all cookies across all domains stored in the global cookie store returning a Java CompletableFuture.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.signature: fun setCookie(url: String, name: String, value: String, domain: String? = null, path: String = "/", isSecure: Boolean = false, isHttpOnly: Boolean = false, expires: Date? = null): Boolean
methods.description: Sets a cookie for the specified url.

methods.name: deleteCookie
methods.signature: fun deleteCookie(url: String, name: String): Boolean
methods.description: Deletes a specific cookie for the specified url.

methods.name: clearCookies
methods.description: Deletes all cookies from the cookie store.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the cookie store to disk to ensure session persistence.

frameworkExamples.code:
import org.daviante.kromium.api.core.KromiumEngine

suspend fun manageCookies(engine: KromiumEngine) {
    val cookieManager = engine.cookieManager
    cookieManager.setCookie(
        url = "https://example.com",
        name = "auth_token",
        value = "secret-token-123",
        isSecure = true,
        isHttpOnly = true
    )
    val token = cookieManager.getCookie("https://example.com", "auth_token")
    cookieManager.flush()
}
